senses.gloss:
mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
1 Chief, principal.
2 Prior, first.
3 Excessive, more, much.
4 Excellent, best.
n. (-ग्रं)
1 Front, fore part.
2 Top, summit, upper part.
3 End, point.
4 Goal, resting place.
5 Assemblage, multitude.
6 A weight equal to one Pala.
7 Limited alms, (four mouthfuls.)
8 (In astronomy) the sun's amplitude.
E.
अगि to go, and the Uṇādi aff. रन् the nasal of the derivative is dropped.

m. (-रः)
1 The tip of the extended hand.
2 The right or better hand.
3 The extremity of a ray of light; the focal point.
E.
अग्र, कर hand or ray.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
To be reckoned or considered as first or best.
E.
अग्र and गण्य to be counted.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Preceding; going before.
E.
अग्र, गामिन् who goes.

m. (-जः)
1 An elder brother; the first-born.
2 A Brahman.
mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
First-born or produced.
E.
अग्र first, ज who is born.

f. (-ङ्घा)
The fore part of the thigh.
E.
अग्र the first part, and जङ्घा thigh.

m. (-न्मा)
1 A priest or Brahman; a man of the sacerdotal tribe.
2 An elder brother or first-born.
3 BRAHMĀ, the first-born of the gods.
E.
अग्र first or best, and जन्मन् birth.

m. (-कः)
A Brahman; a man of the first class.
E.
अग्र, and जातक who is born.

m. (-तिः)
A Brahman; a man of the first class.
E.
अग्र and जाति race, class.

f. (-ज्या)
(In astronomy) Sine of the amplitude.

mfn. (-णीः-णीः-णि)
First, principal.
E.
अग्र and नी, from णीञ्^1 to lead, aff. क्विप्.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 314. note: Cf WIL and WIL1819 णी.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Going before, preceding.
m. (-रः)
A leader.
E.
अग्रतस्, and सर, who goes, from सृ with अच् or ट aff. to go.

ind.
1 Before, in front.
2 Before in rank, &c.
E.
अग्र and तस् aff.

m. (-नी)
A degraded Brahman; one who receives the presents of Śūdras, or things first offered to the deceased.
E.
अग्र, दान gift, इनि poss. aff.

n. (-णं)
Determining beforehand, prophecy, predestination.
E.
अग्र, निरूपण declaring.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant, cowage^1, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
अग्र, पर्ण leaf.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-णिः)
1 The tip of the hand.
2 The right hand.
E.
अग्र, पाणि the hand.

m. (-गः)
1 Part of the top or end.
2 Fore or top part.
3 (In astronomy) Degree of amplitude, also अग्रांशः.
E.
अग्र, भाग part.

mf. (मिः)
A goal, an object, the place or thing to be attained.
E.
अग्र before, भूमि earth.

n. (-सं)
The heart.
E.
अग्र principal, and मांस, flesh.

n. (-नं)
Advancing before an army, for the purpose of defiance; military ardor or daring.
E.
अग्र and यान going.

m. (-जः)
A viviparous plant, as the Gomphroena globosa, &c.
E.
अग्र in front, and वीज seed.

f. (-नी)
The register of human actions, kept by YAMA, the judge of the dead.
E.
अग्र first, and सं, preposition, with धा to take; recording all actions from the original birth.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Preceding, going before, a leader.
E.
अग्र and सर who goes.

m. (-हः)
An anchorite, a man who has retired from the world.
E.
अ neg. and ग्रह a house, being no longer a householder.

m. (-हः)
1 Favour, patronage.
2 Seizing, taking.
3 Surpassing, surmounting.
4 Power, ability.
E.
आङ्, ग्रह to take, अप् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Not to be taken, accepted or acquired.
E.
अ neg. ग्रहणीय to be taken.

m. (-स्तः)
1 The tip of the extended hand.
2 The tip of an elephant's trunk.
2 The right or better hand.
E.
अग्र, हल hand, &c.

m. (-णः)
The name of a month; the eighth of the lunar year of the Hindus, when the moon is full near the head of Orion, or about November-December.
E.
अग्र and हायन, year; according to the ancient system, the first month of the Hindu year: also आग्रहायण.

m. (-णः)
A month so called, the first of the Hindu year according to some systems, (November-December.)
E.
अप beginning, and हायन a year; also अग्रहायण, the अ being unchanged.

m. (-रः)
1 An endowment of lands or villages conferred upon Brahmans.
2 A field of corn.
E.
अग्र chief (tribe), हृ to take, घञ् aff.

m. (-शः)
See अग्रभाग.

m. (-शुः)
The extreme ray or point of a ray of light, the focal point.
E.
अग्र, अंशु a ray.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
1 Not fit or proper to be accepted.
2 Not to be attained.
3 Not to be trusted or consented to.
E.
अ neg. ग्राह्य to be taken.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Chief, principal, best.
2 Elder, elder born.
f. (-मा)
The name of a fruit, (Annona reticulata.) See लवनी.
E.
अग्र and डिमच् aff.

m. (-यः)
An elder brother.
mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
chief, principal.
E.
अग्र and इय or ईय aff. whence also अग्रीय.

f. (-ग्रुः)
A finger.
E.
अग to go, and रु aff.

m. (-गाः)
A leader, a preceder.
E.
अग्रे in front, गा who goes.

m. (-गूः)
A leader.
E.
अग्रे, ग from गम to go, and ऊ Uṇādi aff.

m. (-षुः)
A man of either of the three first classes, whose wife has been before married, and has borne him children.
E.
अग्रे principal, and दिघिषु the husband of a twice married woman.
f. (-षुः)
A younger sister married before her elder; also अग्रेदिघिषू.

n. (-नं)
The skirts of a wood.
E.
अग्रे the fore-part, and वन a wood.

m. (-रः)
A leader.
mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Preceding, going before.
E.
अग्रे in front, and सर who goes.

m. (-कः)
A leader.
E.
अग्रे in front, and सरिक who goes.

mfn. (-ग्र्यः-ग्र्या-ग्र्यं)
Chief, principal.
m. (-ग्र्यः)
An elder brother.
E.
अग्र, and यत् aff.

m. (-कः)
The month Āgrahāyaṇa.
E.
अग्रहायण and ठक् aff.

f. (-णी)
1 The name of a constellation consisting of three stars, one of which is λ Orionis, figured by an antelope's [] head, hence also मृगशिरस्.
2 The day of full moon in the month Āgrahāyaṇa.
E.
अग्रहायण and ङीप् aff.

n. (-णं)
A sacrifice offered when the new rice or wheat ripens.
E.
अग्र chief, अयन coming, अण् aff.

f. (-ष्टिः)
A particular ceremony: see the last.
E.
आग्रायण and इष्टि a sacrifice.
